source.title: Electronic (OSCAL) Version of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5.2.0 Controls and SP 800-53A Rev 5.2.0 Assessment Procedures

requirements.title: Policy and Procedures
requirements.officialText:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] access control policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the access control policy and the associated access controls;
b. Designate an [Assignment: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the access control policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current access control:
  1. Policy [Assignment: frequency] and following [Assignment: events] ; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: frequency] and following [Assignment: events].

requirements.title: Account Management
Account Management | Automated System Account Management
requirements.officialText: Support the management of system accounts using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Account Management | Automated Temporary and Emergency Account Management
requirements.officialText: Automatically [Selection: remove; disable] temporary and emergency accounts after [Assignment: time period].

requirements.title: Account Management | Disable Accounts
Account Management | Automated Audit Actions
requirements.officialText: Automatically audit account creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal actions.

requirements.title: Account Management | Inactivity Logout
requirements.officialText: Require that users log out when [Assignment: time period of expected inactivity or description of when to log out].

requirements.title: Account Management | Dynamic Privilege Management
requirements.officialText: Implement [Assignment: dynamic privilege management capabilities].

requirements.title: Account Management | Privileged User Accounts
Account Management | Dynamic Account Management
requirements.officialText: Create, activate, manage, and deactivate [Assignment: system accounts] dynamically.

requirements.title: Account Management | Restrictions on Use of Shared and Group Accounts
requirements.officialText: Only permit the use of shared and group accounts that meet [Assignment: conditions].

requirements.title: Account Management | Usage Conditions
requirements.officialText: Enforce [Assignment: circumstances and/or usage conditions] for [Assignment: system accounts].

requirements.title: Account Management | Account Monitoring for Atypical Usage
requirements.officialText:
(a) Monitor system accounts for [Assignment: atypical usage] ; and
(b) Report atypical usage of system accounts to [Assignment: personnel or roles].

requirements.title: Account Management | Disable Accounts for High-risk Individuals
requirements.officialText: Disable accounts of individuals within [Assignment: time period] of discovery of [Assignment: significant risks].

requirements.title: Access Enforcement
requirements.officialText: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Dual Authorization
requirements.officialText: Enforce dual authorization for [Assignment: privileged commands and/or other actions].

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Mandatory Access Control
Access Enforcement | Discretionary Access Control
Access Enforcement | Security-relevant Information
requirements.officialText: Prevent access to [Assignment: security-relevant information] except during secure, non-operable system states.

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Role-based Access Control
requirements.officialText: Enforce a role-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects and control access based upon [Assignment: organization-defined roles and users authorized to assume such roles].

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Revocation of Access Authorizations
requirements.officialText: Enforce the revocation of access authorizations resulting from changes to the security attributes of subjects and objects based on [Assignment: rules].

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Controlled Release
requirements.officialText:
Release information outside of the system only if:
  (a) The receiving [Assignment: system or system component] provides [Assignment: controls] ; and
  (b) [Assignment: controls] are used to validate the appropriateness of the information designated for release.

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Audited Override of Access Control Mechanisms
requirements.officialText: Employ an audited override of automated access control mechanisms under [Assignment: conditions] by [Assignment: roles].

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Restrict Access to Specific Information Types
requirements.officialText: Restrict access to data repositories containing [Assignment: information types].

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Assert and Enforce Application Access
Access Enforcement | Attribute-based Access Control
requirements.officialText: Enforce attribute-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects and control access based upon [Assignment: attributes].

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Individual Access
requirements.officialText: Provide [Assignment: mechanisms] to enable individuals to have access to the following elements of their personally identifiable information: [Assignment: elements].

requirements.title: Access Enforcement | Discretionary and Mandatory Access Control
requirements.officialText:
(a) Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined mandatory access control policy] over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy; and
(b) Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined discretionary access control policy] over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement
requirements.officialText: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems based on [Assignment: information flow control policies].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Object Security and Privacy Attributes
requirements.officialText: Use [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] associated with [Assignment: organization-defined information, source, and destination objects] to enforce [Assignment: information flow control policies] as a basis for flow control decisions.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Processing Domains
requirements.officialText: Use protected processing domains to enforce [Assignment: information flow control policies] as a basis for flow control decisions.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Dynamic Information Flow Control
requirements.officialText: Enforce [Assignment: information flow control policies].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Flow Control of Encrypted Information
requirements.officialText: Prevent encrypted information from bypassing [Assignment: information flow control mechanisms] by [Selection (one or more): decrypting the information; blocking the flow of the encrypted information; terminating communications sessions attempting to pass encrypted information; [Assignment: organization-defined procedure or method] ].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Embedded Data Types
requirements.officialText: Enforce [Assignment: limitations] on embedding data types within other data types.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Metadata
requirements.officialText: Enforce information flow control based on [Assignment: metadata].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | One-way Flow Mechanisms
requirements.officialText: Enforce one-way information flows through hardware-based flow control mechanisms.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Security and Privacy Policy Filters
requirements.officialText:
(a) Enforce information flow control using [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] as a basis for flow control decisions for [Assignment: organization-defined information flows] ; and
(b) [Selection (one or more): block; strip; modify; quarantine] data after a filter processing failure in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Human Reviews
requirements.officialText: Enforce the use of human reviews for [Assignment: information flows] under the following conditions: [Assignment: conditions].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Enable and Disable Security or Privacy Policy Filters
requirements.officialText: Provide the capability for privileged administrators to enable and disable [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] under the following conditions: [Assignment: organization-defined conditions].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Configuration of Security or Privacy Policy Filters
requirements.officialText: Provide the capability for privileged administrators to configure [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] to support different security or privacy policies.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Data Type Identifiers
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, use [Assignment: data type identifiers] to validate data essential for information flow decisions.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Decomposition into Policy-relevant Subcomponents
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, decompose information into [Assignment: policy-relevant subcomponents] for submission to policy enforcement mechanisms.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Security or Privacy Policy Filter Constraints
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, implement [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] requiring fully enumerated formats that restrict data structure and content.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Detection of Unsanctioned Information
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, examine the information for the presence of [Assignment: unsanctioned information] and prohibit the transfer of such information in accordance with the [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Domain Authentication
requirements.officialText: Uniquely identify and authenticate source and destination points by [Selection (one or more): organization, system, application, service, individual] for information transfer.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Validation of Metadata
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, implement [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] on metadata.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Approved Solutions
requirements.officialText: Employ [Assignment: solutions in approved configurations] to control the flow of [Assignment: information] across security domains.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Physical or Logical Separation of Information Flows
requirements.officialText: Separate information flows logically or physically using [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms and/or techniques] to accomplish [Assignment: required separations].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Access Only
requirements.officialText: Provide access from a single device to computing platforms, applications, or data residing in multiple different security domains, while preventing information flow between the different security domains.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Modify Non-releasable Information
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, modify non-releasable information by implementing [Assignment: modification action].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Internal Normalized Format
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, parse incoming data into an internal normalized format and regenerate the data to be consistent with its intended specification.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Data Sanitization
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, sanitize data to minimize [Selection (one or more): delivery of malicious content, command and control of malicious code, malicious code augmentation, and steganography-encoded data; spillage of sensitive information] in accordance with [Assignment: policy].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Audit Filtering Actions
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, record and audit content filtering actions and results for the information being filtered.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Redundant/Independent Filtering Mechanisms
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, implement content filtering solutions that provide redundant and independent filtering mechanisms for each data type.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Linear Filter Pipelines
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, implement a linear content filter pipeline that is enforced with discretionary and mandatory access controls.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Filter Orchestration Engines
requirements.officialText:
When transferring information between different security domains, employ content filter orchestration engines to ensure that:
  (a) Content filtering mechanisms successfully complete execution without errors; and
  (b) Content filtering actions occur in the correct order and comply with [Assignment: policy].

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Filter Mechanisms Using Multiple Processes
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, implement content filtering mechanisms using multiple processes.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Failed Content Transfer Prevention
requirements.officialText: When transferring information between different security domains, prevent the transfer of failed content to the receiving domain.

requirements.title: Information Flow Enforcement | Process Requirements for Information Transfer
Separation of Duties
requirements.officialText:
a. Identify and document [Assignment: duties of individuals] ; and
b. Define system access authorizations to support separation of duties.

requirements.title: Least Privilege
requirements.officialText: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Authorize Access to Security Functions
requirements.officialText:
Authorize access for [Assignment: individuals and roles] to:
  (a) [Assignment: organization-defined security functions (deployed in hardware, software, and firmware)] ; and
  (b) [Assignment: security-relevant information].

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Non-privileged Access for Nonsecurity Functions
requirements.officialText: Require that users of system accounts (or roles) with access to [Assignment: security functions or security-relevant information] use non-privileged accounts or roles, when accessing nonsecurity functions.

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Network Access to Privileged Commands
requirements.officialText: Authorize network access to [Assignment: privileged commands] only for [Assignment: compelling operational needs] and document the rationale for such access in the security plan for the system.

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Separate Processing Domains
requirements.officialText: Provide separate processing domains to enable finer-grained allocation of user privileges.

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Privileged Accounts
requirements.officialText: Restrict privileged accounts on the system to [Assignment: personnel or roles].

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Privileged Access by Non-organizational Users
requirements.officialText: Prohibit privileged access to the system by non-organizational users.

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Review of User Privileges
requirements.officialText:
(a) Review [Assignment: frequency] the privileges assigned to [Assignment: roles and classes] to validate the need for such privileges; and
(b) Reassign or remove privileges, if necessary, to correctly reflect organizational mission and business needs.

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Privilege Levels for Code Execution
requirements.officialText: Prevent the following software from executing at higher privilege levels than users executing the software: [Assignment: software].

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Log Use of Privileged Functions
requirements.officialText: Log the execution of privileged functions.

requirements.title: Least Privilege | Prohibit Non-privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions
requirements.officialText: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions.

requirements.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
requirements.officialText:
a. Enforce a limit of [Assignment: number] consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a [Assignment: time period] ; and
b. Automatically [Selection (one or more): lock the account or node for [Assignment: time period] ; lock the account or node until released by an administrator; delay next logon prompt per [Assignment: delay algorithm] ; notify system administrator; take other [Assignment: action] ] when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.

requirements.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts | Purge or Wipe Mobile Device
requirements.officialText: Purge or wipe information from [Assignment: mobile devices] based on [Assignment: purging or wiping requirements and techniques] after [Assignment: number] consecutive, unsuccessful device logon attempts.

requirements.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts | Biometric Attempt Limiting
requirements.officialText: Limit the number of unsuccessful biometric logon attempts to [Assignment: number].

requirements.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts | Use of Alternate Authentication Factor
requirements.officialText:
(a) Allow the use of [Assignment: authentication factors] that are different from the primary authentication factors after the number of organization-defined consecutive invalid logon attempts have been exceeded; and
(b) Enforce a limit of [Assignment: number] consecutive invalid logon attempts through use of the alternative factors by a user during a [Assignment: time period].

requirements.title: System Use Notification
Previous Logon Notification
requirements.officialText: Notify the user, upon successful logon to the system, of the date and time of the last logon.

requirements.title: Previous Logon Notification | Unsuccessful Logons
requirements.officialText: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the number of unsuccessful logon attempts since the last successful logon.

requirements.title: Previous Logon Notification | Successful and Unsuccessful Logons
requirements.officialText: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the number of [Selection: successful logons; unsuccessful logon attempts; both] during [Assignment: time period].

requirements.title: Previous Logon Notification | Notification of Account Changes
requirements.officialText: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of changes to [Assignment: security-related characteristics or parameters] during [Assignment: time period].

requirements.title: Previous Logon Notification | Additional Logon Information
requirements.officialText: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the following additional information: [Assignment: additional information].

requirements.title: Concurrent Session Control
requirements.officialText: Limit the number of concurrent sessions for each [Assignment: account and/or account types] to [Assignment: number].

requirements.title: Device Lock
requirements.officialText:
a. Prevent further access to the system by [Selection (one or more): initiating a device lock after [Assignment: time period] of inactivity; requiring the user to initiate a device lock before leaving the system unattended] ; and
b. Retain the device lock until the user reestablishes access using established identification and authentication procedures.

requirements.title: Device Lock | Pattern-hiding Displays
requirements.officialText: Conceal, via the device lock, information previously visible on the display with a publicly viewable image.

requirements.title: Session Termination
requirements.officialText: Automatically terminate a user session after [Assignment: conditions or trigger events].

requirements.title: Session Termination | User-initiated Logouts
requirements.officialText: Provide a logout capability for user-initiated communications sessions whenever authentication is used to gain access to [Assignment: information resources].

requirements.title: Session Termination | Termination Message
requirements.officialText: Display an explicit logout message to users indicating the termination of authenticated communications sessions.

requirements.title: Session Termination | Timeout Warning Message
requirements.officialText: Display an explicit message to users indicating that the session will end in [Assignment: time].

requirements.title: Permitted Actions Without Identification or Authentication
requirements.officialText:
a. Identify [Assignment: user actions] that can be performed on the system without identification or authentication consistent with organizational mission and business functions; and
b. Document and provide supporting rationale in the security plan for the system, user actions not requiring identification or authentication.

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes
Security and Privacy Attributes | Dynamic Attribute Association
requirements.officialText: Dynamically associate security and privacy attributes with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] in accordance with the following security and privacy policies as information is created and combined: [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy policies].

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Value Changes by Authorized Individuals
requirements.officialText: Provide authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) the capability to define or change the value of associated security and privacy attributes.

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Maintenance of Attribute Associations by System
requirements.officialText: Maintain the association and integrity of [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] to [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects].

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Association of Attributes by Authorized Individuals
requirements.officialText: Provide the capability to associate [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals).

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Displays on Objects to Be Output
requirements.officialText: Display security and privacy attributes in human-readable form on each object that the system transmits to output devices to identify [Assignment: instructions] using [Assignment: naming conventions].

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Maintenance of Attribute Association
requirements.officialText: Require personnel to associate and maintain the association of [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy policies].

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Consistent Attribute Interpretation
requirements.officialText: Provide a consistent interpretation of security and privacy attributes transmitted between distributed system components.

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Association Techniques and Technologies
requirements.officialText: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined techniques and technologies] in associating security and privacy attributes to information.

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Reassignment — Regrading Mechanisms
requirements.officialText: Change security and privacy attributes associated with information only via regrading mechanisms validated using [Assignment: organization-defined techniques or procedures].

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Attributes | Attribute Configuration by Authorized Individuals
requirements.officialText: Provide authorized individuals the capability to define or change the type and value of security and privacy attributes available for association with subjects and objects.

requirements.title: Remote Access
requirements.officialText:
a. Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed; and
b. Authorize each type of remote access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

requirements.title: Remote Access | Monitoring and Control
requirements.officialText: Employ automated mechanisms to monitor and control remote access methods.

requirements.title: Remote Access | Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
requirements.officialText: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions.

requirements.title: Remote Access | Managed Access Control Points
requirements.officialText: Route remote accesses through authorized and managed network access control points.

requirements.title: Remote Access | Privileged Commands and Access
requirements.officialText:
(a) Authorize the execution of privileged commands and access to security-relevant information via remote access only in a format that provides assessable evidence and for the following needs: [Assignment: organization-defined needs] ; and
(b) Document the rationale for remote access in the security plan for the system.

requirements.title: Remote Access | Protection of Mechanism Information
requirements.officialText: Protect information about remote access mechanisms from unauthorized use and disclosure.

requirements.title: Remote Access | Disconnect or Disable Access
requirements.officialText: Provide the capability to disconnect or disable remote access to the system within [Assignment: time period].

requirements.title: Remote Access | Authenticate Remote Commands
requirements.officialText: Implement [Assignment: mechanisms] to authenticate [Assignment: remote commands].

requirements.title: Wireless Access
requirements.officialText:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of wireless access; and
b. Authorize each type of wireless access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

requirements.title: Wireless Access | Authentication and Encryption
requirements.officialText: Protect wireless access to the system using authentication of [Selection (one or more): users; devices] and encryption.

requirements.title: Wireless Access | Disable Wireless Networking
requirements.officialText: Disable, when not intended for use, wireless networking capabilities embedded within system components prior to issuance and deployment.

requirements.title: Wireless Access | Restrict Configurations by Users
requirements.officialText: Identify and explicitly authorize users allowed to independently configure wireless networking capabilities.

requirements.title: Wireless Access | Antennas and Transmission Power Levels
requirements.officialText: Select radio antennas and calibrate transmission power levels to reduce the probability that signals from wireless access points can be received outside of organization-controlled boundaries.

requirements.title: Access Control for Mobile Devices
requirements.officialText:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for organization-controlled mobile devices, to include when such devices are outside of controlled areas; and
b. Authorize the connection of mobile devices to organizational systems.

requirements.title: Access Control for Mobile Devices | Restrictions for Classified Information
requirements.officialText:
(a) Prohibit the use of unclassified mobile devices in facilities containing systems processing, storing, or transmitting classified information unless specifically permitted by the authorizing official; and
(b) Enforce the following restrictions on individuals permitted by the authorizing official to use unclassified mobile devices in facilities containing systems processing, storing, or transmitting classified information:
  (1) Connection of unclassified mobile devices to classified systems is prohibited;
  (2) Connection of unclassified mobile devices to unclassified systems requires approval from the authorizing official;
  (3) Use of internal or external modems or wireless interfaces within the unclassified mobile devices is prohibited; and
  (4) Unclassified mobile devices and the information stored on those devices are subject to random reviews and inspections by [Assignment: security officials] , and if classified information is found, the incident handling policy is followed.
(c) Restrict the connection of classified mobile devices to classified systems in accordance with [Assignment: security policies].

requirements.title: Access Control for Mobile Devices | Full Device or Container-based Encryption
requirements.officialText: Employ [Selection: full-device encryption; container-based encryption] to protect the confidentiality and integrity of information on [Assignment: mobile devices].

requirements.title: Use of External Systems
requirements.officialText:
a. [Selection (one or more): establish [Assignment: terms and conditions] ; identify [Assignment: controls asserted] ] , consistent with the trust relationships established with other organizations owning, operating, and/or maintaining external systems, allowing authorized individuals to:
  1. Access the system from external systems; and
  2. Process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information using external systems; or
b. Prohibit the use of [Assignment: prohibited types of external systems].

requirements.title: Use of External Systems | Limits on Authorized Use
requirements.officialText:
Permit authorized individuals to use an external system to access the system or to process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information only after:
  (a) Verification of the implementation of controls on the external system as specified in the organization’s security and privacy policies and security and privacy plans; or
  (b) Retention of approved system connection or processing agreements with the organizational entity hosting the external system.

requirements.title: Use of External Systems | Portable Storage Devices — Restricted Use
requirements.officialText: Restrict the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external systems using [Assignment: restrictions].

requirements.title: Use of External Systems | Non-organizationally Owned Systems — Restricted Use
requirements.officialText: Restrict the use of non-organizationally owned systems or system components to process, store, or transmit organizational information using [Assignment: restrictions].

requirements.title: Use of External Systems | Network Accessible Storage Devices — Prohibited Use
requirements.officialText: Prohibit the use of [Assignment: network-accessible storage devices] in external systems.

requirements.title: Use of External Systems | Portable Storage Devices — Prohibited Use
requirements.officialText: Prohibit the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external systems.

requirements.title: Information Sharing
requirements.officialText:
a. Enable authorized users to determine whether access authorizations assigned to a sharing partner match the information’s access and use restrictions for [Assignment: information-sharing circumstances] ; and
b. Employ [Assignment: automated mechanisms] to assist users in making information sharing and collaboration decisions.

requirements.title: Information Sharing | Automated Decision Support
requirements.officialText: Employ [Assignment: automated mechanisms] to enforce information-sharing decisions by authorized users based on access authorizations of sharing partners and access restrictions on information to be shared.

requirements.title: Information Sharing | Information Search and Retrieval
requirements.officialText: Implement information search and retrieval services that enforce [Assignment: information-sharing restrictions].

requirements.title: Publicly Accessible Content
Data Mining Protection
requirements.officialText: Employ [Assignment: techniques] for [Assignment: data storage objects] to detect and protect against unauthorized data mining.

requirements.title: Access Control Decisions
requirements.officialText: [Selection (one or more): establish procedures; implement mechanisms] to ensure [Assignment: access control decisions] are applied to each access request prior to access enforcement.

requirements.title: Access Control Decisions | Transmit Access Authorization Information
requirements.officialText: Transmit [Assignment: access authorization information] using [Assignment: controls] to [Assignment: systems] that enforce access control decisions.

requirements.title: Access Control Decisions | No User or Process Identity
requirements.officialText: Enforce access control decisions based on [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy attributes] that do not include the identity of the user or process acting on behalf of the user.

requirements.title: Reference Monitor
requirements.officialText: Implement a reference monitor for [Assignment: access control policies] that is tamperproof, always invoked, and small enough to be subject to analysis and testing, the completeness of which can be assured.

requirements.title: Policy and Procedures
requirements.officialText:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] awareness and training policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the awareness and training policy and the associated awareness and training controls;
b. Designate an [Assignment: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the awareness and training policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current awareness and training:
  1. Policy [Assignment: frequency] and following [Assignment: events] ; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: frequency] and following [Assignment: events].

requirements.title: Literacy Training and Awareness
Literacy Training and Awareness | Practical Exercises
requirements.officialText: Provide practical exercises in literacy training that simulate events and incidents.

requirements.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Insider Threat
requirements.officialText: Provide literacy training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.

requirements.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Social Engineering and Mining
requirements.officialText: Provide literacy training on recognizing and reporting potential and actual instances of social engineering and social mining.

requirements.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Suspicious Communications and Anomalous System Behavior
requirements.officialText: Provide literacy training on recognizing suspicious communications and anomalous behavior in organizational systems using [Assignment: indicators of malicious code].

requirements.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Advanced Persistent Threat
requirements.officialText: Provide literacy training on the advanced persistent threat.

requirements.title: Literacy Training and Awareness | Cyber Threat Environment
requirements.officialText:
(a) Provide literacy training on the cyber threat environment; and
(b) Reflect current cyber threat information in system operations.

requirements.title: Role-based Training
requirements.officialText:
a. Provide role-based security and privacy training to personnel with the following roles and responsibilities: [Assignment: organization-defined roles and responsibilities]:
  1. Before authorizing access to the system, information, or performing assigned duties, and [Assignment: frequency] thereafter; and
  2. When required by system changes;
b. Update role-based training content [Assignment: frequency] and following [Assignment: events] ; and
c. Incorporate lessons learned from internal or external security incidents or breaches into role-based training.

requirements.title: Role-based Training | Environmental Controls
requirements.officialText: Provide [Assignment: personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: frequency] training in the employment and operation of environmental controls.

requirements.title: Role-based Training | Physical Security Controls
requirements.officialText: Provide [Assignment: personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: frequency] training in the employment and operation of physical security controls.

requirements.title: Role-based Training | Practical Exercises
requirements.officialText: Provide practical exercises in security and privacy training that reinforce training objectives.

requirements.title: Role-based Training | Processing Personally Identifiable Information
requirements.officialText: Provide [Assignment: personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: frequency] training in the employment and operation of personally identifiable information processing and transparency controls.

requirements.title: Training Records
requirements.officialText:

requirements.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting

requirements.officialText: Integrate audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlate Audit Record Repositories
requirements.officialText: Analyze and correlate audit records across different repositories to gain organization-wide situational awareness.

requirements.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Central Review and Analysis

requirements.officialText: Integrate analysis of audit records with analysis of [Selection (one or more): vulnerability scanning information; performance data; system monitoring information; [Assignment: data/information collected from other sources] ] to further enhance the ability to identify inappropriate or unusual activity.

requirements.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlation with Physical Monitoring

requirements.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting | Correlation with Information from Nontechnical Sources
requirements.officialText: Correlate information from nontechnical sources with audit record information to enhance organization-wide situational awareness.

requirements.title: Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation
requirements.officialText:

requirements.title: Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation | Automatic Processing
requirements.officialText: Provide and implement the capability to process, sort, and search audit records for events of interest based on the following content: [Assignment: fields within audit records].

requirements.title: Protection of Audit Information
requirements.officialText:
a. Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion; and
b. Alert [Assignment: personnel or roles] upon detection of unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of audit information.

requirements.title: Protection of Audit Information | Hardware Write-once Media
requirements.officialText: Write audit trails to hardware-enforced, write-once media.

requirements.title: Protection of Audit Information | Store on Separate Physical Systems or Components
requirements.officialText: Store audit records [Assignment: frequency] in a repository that is part of a physically different system or system component than the system or component being audited.

requirements.title: Protection of Audit Information | Cryptographic Protection
requirements.officialText: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of audit information and audit tools.

requirements.title: Protection of Audit Information | Access by Subset of Privileged Users
requirements.officialText: Authorize access to management of audit logging functionality to only [Assignment: subset of privileged users or roles].

requirements.title: Protection of Audit Information | Dual Authorization
requirements.officialText: Enforce dual authorization for [Selection (one or more): movement; deletion] of [Assignment: audit information].

requirements.title: Protection of Audit Information | Read-only Access
requirements.officialText: Authorize read-only access to audit information to [Assignment: subset of privileged users or roles].

requirements.title: Protection of Audit Information | Store on Component with Different Operating System
requirements.officialText: Store audit information on a component running a different operating system than the system or component being audited.

requirements.officialText: Compile audit records from [Assignment: system components] into a system-wide (logical or physical) audit trail that is time-correlated to within [Assignment: level of tolerance].

requirements.title: Audit Record Generation | Standardized Formats
requirements.officialText: Produce a system-wide (logical or physical) audit trail composed of audit records in a standardized format.

requirements.officialText: Provide and implement the capability for [Assignment: individuals or roles] to change the logging to be performed on [Assignment: system components] based on [Assignment: selectable event criteria] within [Assignment: time thresholds].

requirements.title: Audit Record Generation | Query Parameter Audits of Personally Identifiable Information
requirements.officialText: Provide and implement the capability for auditing the parameters of user query events for data sets containing personally identifiable information.

requirements.title: Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Use of Automated Tools
requirements.officialText: Monitor open-source information and information sites using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Review of Monitored Sites
requirements.officialText: Review the list of open-source information sites being monitored [Assignment: frequency].

requirements.title: Monitoring for Information Disclosure | Unauthorized Replication of Information
requirements.officialText: Employ discovery techniques, processes, and tools to determine if external entities are replicating organizational information in an unauthorized manner.

requirements.title: Session Audit | Remote Viewing and Listening
requirements.officialText: Provide and implement the capability for authorized users to remotely view and hear content related to an established user session in real time.

requirements.officialText: Preserve the identity of individuals in cross-organizational audit trails.

requirements.officialText: Provide cross-organizational audit information to [Assignment: organizations] based on [Assignment: cross-organizational sharing agreements].

requirements.officialText: Implement [Assignment: measures] to disassociate individuals from audit information transmitted across organizational boundaries.

requirements.title: Control Assessments | Specialized Assessments
requirements.officialText: Include as part of control assessments, [Assignment: specialized assessment frequency], [Selection: announced; unannounced], [Selection (one or more): in-depth monitoring; security instrumentation; automated security test cases; vulnerability scanning; malicious user testing; insider threat assessment; performance and load testing; data leakage or data loss assessment; [Assignment: other forms of assessment] ].

requirements.officialText: Leverage the results of control assessments performed by [Assignment: external organization(s)] on [Assignment: system] when the assessment meets [Assignment: requirements].

requirements.title: Information Exchange

requirements.officialText: Verify that individuals or systems transferring data between interconnecting systems have the requisite authorizations (i.e., write permissions or privileges) prior to accepting such data.

requirements.title: Information Exchange | Transitive Information Exchanges
requirements.officialText:
(a) Identify transitive (downstream) information exchanges with other systems through the systems identified in [CA-3a](#ca-3_smt.a) ; and
(b) Take measures to ensure that transitive (downstream) information exchanges cease when the controls on identified transitive (downstream) systems cannot be verified or validated.

requirements.title: Plan of Action and Milestones
requirements.officialText:
a. Develop a plan of action and milestones for the system to document the planned remediation actions of the organization to correct weaknesses or deficiencies noted during the assessment of the controls and to reduce or eliminate known vulnerabilities in the system; and
b. Update existing plan of action and milestones [Assignment: frequency] based on the findings from control assessments, independent audits or reviews, and continuous monitoring activities.

requirements.title: Plan of Action and Milestones | Automation Support for Accuracy and Currency
requirements.officialText: Ensure the accuracy, currency, and availability of the plan of action and milestones for the system using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.officialText: Employ a joint authorization process for the system that includes multiple authorizing officials from the same organization conducting the authorization.

requirements.title: Authorization | Joint Authorization — Inter-organization
requirements.officialText: Employ a joint authorization process for the system that includes multiple authorizing officials with at least one authorizing official from an organization external to the organization conducting the authorization.

requirements.title: Continuous Monitoring
Continuous Monitoring | Independent Assessment
requirements.officialText: Employ independent assessors or assessment teams to monitor the controls in the system on an ongoing basis.

requirements.title: Continuous Monitoring | Trend Analyses
requirements.officialText: Employ trend analyses to determine if control implementations, the frequency of continuous monitoring activities, and the types of activities used in the continuous monitoring process need to be modified based on empirical data.

requirements.title: Continuous Monitoring | Risk Monitoring
requirements.officialText:
Ensure risk monitoring is an integral part of the continuous monitoring strategy that includes the following:
  (a) Effectiveness monitoring;
  (b) Compliance monitoring; and
  (c) Change monitoring.

requirements.title: Continuous Monitoring | Consistency Analysis
requirements.officialText: Employ the following actions to validate that policies are established and implemented controls are operating in a consistent manner: [Assignment: organization-defined actions].

requirements.title: Continuous Monitoring | Automation Support for Monitoring
requirements.officialText: Ensure the accuracy, currency, and availability of monitoring results for the system using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Penetration Testing
requirements.officialText: Conduct penetration testing [Assignment: frequency] on [Assignment: system(s) or system components].

requirements.officialText: Employ an independent penetration testing agent or team to perform penetration testing on the system or system components.

requirements.title: Penetration Testing | Red Team Exercises
requirements.officialText: Employ the following red-team exercises to simulate attempts by adversaries to compromise organizational systems in accordance with applicable rules of engagement: [Assignment: red team exercises].

requirements.officialText: Employ a penetration testing process that includes [Assignment: frequency] [Selection (one or more): announced; unannounced] attempts to bypass or circumvent controls associated with physical access points to the facility.

requirements.title: Baseline Configuration | Retention of Previous Configurations
requirements.officialText: Retain [Assignment: number] of previous versions of baseline configurations of the system to support rollback.

requirements.officialText: Maintain a baseline configuration for system development and test environments that is managed separately from the operational baseline configuration.

requirements.officialText:

Configuration Change Control | Testing, Validation, and Documentation of Changes
requirements.officialText: Test, validate, and document changes to the system before finalizing the implementation of the changes.

requirements.title: Configuration Change Control | Automated Change Implementation
requirements.officialText: Implement changes to the current system baseline and deploy the updated baseline across the installed base using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Configuration Change Control | Security and Privacy Representatives
requirements.officialText: Require [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy representatives] to be members of the [Assignment: configuration change control element].

requirements.officialText: Implement the following security responses automatically if baseline configurations are changed in an unauthorized manner: [Assignment: security responses].

requirements.officialText: Review changes to the system [Assignment: frequency] or when [Assignment: circumstances] to determine whether unauthorized changes have occurred.

requirements.title: Impact Analyses
requirements.officialText: Analyze changes to the system to determine potential security and privacy impacts prior to change implementation.

requirements.title: Impact Analyses | Separate Test Environments
requirements.officialText: Analyze changes to the system in a separate test environment before implementation in an operational environment, looking for security and privacy impacts due to flaws, weaknesses, incompatibility, or intentional malice.

requirements.title: Impact Analyses | Verification of Controls
requirements.officialText: After system changes, verify that the impacted controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome with regard to meeting the security and privacy requirements for the system.

requirements.officialText:

requirements.title: Access Restrictions for Change | Dual Authorization
requirements.officialText: Enforce dual authorization for implementing changes to [Assignment: organization-defined system components and system-level information].

requirements.officialText: Manage, apply, and verify configuration settings for [Assignment: system components] using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Nonlocal Maintenance | Authentication and Separation of Maintenance Sessions

Protect nonlocal maintenance sessions by:

requirements.title: Nonlocal Maintenance | Approvals and Notifications
requirements.officialText:
(a) Require the approval of each nonlocal maintenance session by [Assignment: personnel or roles] ; and
(b) Notify the following personnel or roles of the date and time of planned nonlocal maintenance: [Assignment: personnel and roles].

requirements.title: Nonlocal Maintenance | Cryptographic Protection
requirements.officialText: Implement the following cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity and confidentiality of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic communications: [Assignment: cryptographic mechanisms].

requirements.title: Nonlocal Maintenance | Disconnect Verification
requirements.officialText: Verify session and network connection termination after the completion of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions.

requirements.title: Maintenance Personnel
Maintenance Personnel | Individuals Without Appropriate Access
requirements.officialText:

  (1) Maintenance personnel who do not have needed access authorizations, clearances, or formal access approvals are escorted and supervised during the performance of maintenance and diagnostic activities on the system by approved organizational personnel who are fully cleared, have appropriate access authorizations, and are technically qualified; and
  (2) Prior to initiating maintenance or diagnostic activities by personnel who do not have needed access authorizations, clearances or formal access approvals, all volatile information storage components within the system are sanitized and all nonvolatile storage media are removed or physically disconnected from the system and secured; and
(b) Develop and implement [Assignment: alternate controls] in the event a system component cannot be sanitized, removed, or disconnected from the system.

requirements.title: Maintenance Personnel | Security Clearances for Classified Systems
requirements.officialText: Verify that personnel performing maintenance and diagnostic activities on a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information possess security clearances and formal access approvals for at least the highest classification level and for compartments of information on the system.

requirements.title: Maintenance Personnel | Citizenship Requirements for Classified Systems
requirements.officialText: Verify that personnel performing maintenance and diagnostic activities on a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information are U.S. citizens.

requirements.title: Maintenance Personnel | Foreign Nationals
requirements.officialText:
Ensure that:
  (a) Foreign nationals with appropriate security clearances are used to conduct maintenance and diagnostic activities on classified systems only when the systems are jointly owned and operated by the United States and foreign allied governments, or owned and operated solely by foreign allied governments; and
  (b) Approvals, consents, and detailed operational conditions regarding the use of foreign nationals to conduct maintenance and diagnostic activities on classified systems are fully documented within Memoranda of Agreements.

requirements.title: Maintenance Personnel | Non-system Maintenance
requirements.officialText: Ensure that non-escorted personnel performing maintenance activities not directly associated with the system but in the physical proximity of the system, have required access authorizations.

requirements.title: Timely Maintenance
requirements.officialText: Obtain maintenance support and/or spare parts for [Assignment: system components] within [Assignment: time period] of failure.

requirements.title: Timely Maintenance | Preventive Maintenance
requirements.officialText: Perform preventive maintenance on [Assignment: system components] at [Assignment: time intervals].

requirements.title: Timely Maintenance | Predictive Maintenance
requirements.officialText: Perform predictive maintenance on [Assignment: system components] at [Assignment: time intervals].

requirements.title: Timely Maintenance | Automated Support for Predictive Maintenance
requirements.officialText: Transfer predictive maintenance data to a maintenance management system using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Field Maintenance
requirements.officialText: Restrict or prohibit field maintenance on [Assignment: systems or system components] to [Assignment: trusted maintenance facilities].

requirements.title: Media Access

requirements.officialText:
a. Mark system media indicating the distribution limitations, handling caveats, and applicable security markings (if any) of the information; and
b. Exempt [Assignment: types of media exempted from marking] from marking if the media remain within [Assignment: controlled areas].

requirements.title: Media Storage
requirements.officialText:
a. Physically control and securely store [Assignment: organization-defined types of digital and/or non-digital media] within [Assignment: organization-defined controlled areas] ; and

requirements.title: Media Storage | Automated Restricted Access
requirements.officialText: Restrict access to media storage areas and log access attempts and access granted using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Media Transport
Media Transport | Custodians
requirements.officialText: Employ an identified custodian during transport of system media outside of controlled areas.

requirements.title: Media Sanitization
requirements.officialText:
a. Sanitize [Assignment: organization-defined system media] prior to disposal, release out of organizational control, or release for reuse using [Assignment: organization-defined sanitization techniques and procedures] ; and
b. Employ sanitization mechanisms with the strength and integrity commensurate with the security category or classification of the information.

requirements.title: Media Sanitization | Review, Approve, Track, Document, and Verify
requirements.officialText: Review, approve, track, document, and verify media sanitization and disposal actions.

requirements.title: Media Sanitization | Equipment Testing
requirements.officialText: Test sanitization equipment and procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to ensure that the intended sanitization is being achieved.

requirements.title: Media Sanitization | Nondestructive Techniques
requirements.officialText: Apply nondestructive sanitization techniques to portable storage devices prior to connecting such devices to the system under the following circumstances: [Assignment: circumstances].

requirements.title: Media Sanitization | Dual Authorization
requirements.officialText: Enforce dual authorization for the sanitization of [Assignment: system media].

requirements.officialText: Provide the capability to purge or wipe information from [Assignment: systems or system components] [Selection: remotely; under [Assignment: conditions] ].

requirements.title: Media Use
requirements.officialText:
a. [Selection: restrict; prohibit] the use of [Assignment: types of system media] on [Assignment: systems or system components] using [Assignment: controls] ; and

requirements.title: Media Use | Prohibit Use of Sanitization-resistant Media
requirements.officialText: Prohibit the use of sanitization-resistant media in organizational systems.

requirements.title: Media Downgrading
Media Downgrading | Documentation of Process
requirements.officialText: Document system media downgrading actions.

requirements.title: Media Downgrading | Equipment Testing
requirements.officialText: Test downgrading equipment and procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to ensure that downgrading actions are being achieved.

requirements.title: Media Downgrading | Controlled Unclassified Information
requirements.officialText: Downgrade system media containing controlled unclassified information prior to public release.

requirements.title: Media Downgrading | Classified Information
requirements.officialText: Downgrade system media containing classified information prior to release to individuals without required access authorizations.

requirements.title: Policy and Procedures
requirements.officialText:

requirements.title: Physical Access Authorizations
Physical Access Authorizations | Access by Position or Role
requirements.officialText: Authorize physical access to the facility where the system resides based on position or role.

requirements.title: Physical Access Authorizations | Two Forms of Identification
requirements.officialText: Require two forms of identification from the following forms of identification for visitor access to the facility where the system resides: [Assignment: list of acceptable forms of identification].

requirements.title: Physical Access Authorizations | Restrict Unescorted Access
requirements.officialText: Restrict unescorted access to the facility where the system resides to personnel with [Selection (one or more): security clearances for all information contained within the system; formal access authorizations for all information contained within the system; need for access to all information contained within the system; [Assignment: physical access authorizations] ].

requirements.title: Physical Access Control

requirements.officialText: Enforce physical access authorizations to the system in addition to the physical access controls for the facility at [Assignment: physical spaces].

requirements.title: Physical Access Control | Facility and Systems
requirements.officialText: Perform security checks [Assignment: frequency] at the physical perimeter of the facility or system for exfiltration of information or removal of system components.

requirements.title: Physical Access Control | Continuous Guards
requirements.officialText: Employ guards to control [Assignment: physical access points] to the facility where the system resides 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

requirements.title: Physical Access Control | Lockable Casings
requirements.officialText: Use lockable physical casings to protect [Assignment: system components] from unauthorized physical access.

requirements.title: Physical Access Control | Tamper Protection
requirements.officialText: Employ [Assignment: anti-tamper technologies] to [Selection (one or more): detect; prevent] physical tampering or alteration of [Assignment: hardware components] within the system.

requirements.title: Physical Access Control | Physical Barriers
requirements.officialText: Limit access using physical barriers.

requirements.title: Physical Access Control | Access Control Vestibules
requirements.officialText: Employ access control vestibules at [Assignment: locations].

requirements.title: Access Control for Transmission
requirements.officialText: Control physical access to [Assignment: system distribution and transmission lines] within organizational facilities using [Assignment: security controls].

requirements.title: Access Control for Output Devices
requirements.officialText: Control physical access to output from [Assignment: output devices] to prevent unauthorized individuals from obtaining the output.

requirements.title: Access Control for Output Devices | Link to Individual Identity
requirements.officialText: Link individual identity to receipt of output from output devices.

requirements.title: Monitoring Physical Access
Monitoring Physical Access | Intrusion Alarms and Surveillance Equipment
requirements.officialText: Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides using physical intrusion alarms and surveillance equipment.

requirements.title: Monitoring Physical Access | Automated Intrusion Recognition and Responses
requirements.officialText: Recognize [Assignment: classes or types of intrusions] and initiate [Assignment: response actions] using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Monitoring Physical Access | Video Surveillance
Monitoring Physical Access | Monitoring Physical Access to Systems
requirements.officialText: Monitor physical access to the system in addition to the physical access monitoring of the facility at [Assignment: physical spaces].

requirements.title: Visitor Access Records
Visitor Access Records | Automated Records Maintenance and Review
requirements.officialText: Maintain and review visitor access records using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Visitor Access Records | Limit Personally Identifiable Information Elements
requirements.officialText: Limit personally identifiable information contained in visitor access records to the following elements identified in the privacy risk assessment: [Assignment: elements].

requirements.title: Power Equipment and Cabling
requirements.officialText: Protect power equipment and power cabling for the system from damage and destruction.

requirements.title: Power Equipment and Cabling | Redundant Cabling
requirements.officialText: Employ redundant power cabling paths that are physically separated by [Assignment: distance].

requirements.title: Power Equipment and Cabling | Automatic Voltage Controls
requirements.officialText: Employ automatic voltage controls for [Assignment: critical system components].

requirements.title: Emergency Shutoff
Emergency Power
requirements.officialText: Provide an uninterruptible power supply to facilitate [Selection: an orderly shutdown of the system; transition of the system to long-term alternate power] in the event of a primary power source loss.

requirements.title: Emergency Power | Alternate Power Supply — Minimal Operational Capability
requirements.officialText: Provide an alternate power supply for the system that is activated [Selection: manually; automatically] and that can maintain minimally required operational capability in the event of an extended loss of the primary power source.

requirements.title: Emergency Power | Alternate Power Supply — Self-contained
requirements.officialText:
Provide an alternate power supply for the system that is activated [Selection: manually; automatically] and that is:
  (a) Self-contained;
  (b) Not reliant on external power generation; and
  (c) Capable of maintaining [Selection: minimally required operational capability; full operational capability] in the event of an extended loss of the primary power source.

requirements.title: Emergency Lighting
requirements.officialText: Employ and maintain automatic emergency lighting for the system that activates in the event of a power outage or disruption and that covers emergency exits and evacuation routes within the facility.

requirements.title: Emergency Lighting | Essential Mission and Business Functions
requirements.officialText: Provide emergency lighting for all areas within the facility supporting essential mission and business functions.

requirements.title: Fire Protection
requirements.officialText: Employ and maintain fire detection and suppression systems that are supported by an independent energy source.

requirements.title: Fire Protection | Detection Systems — Automatic Activation and Notification
requirements.officialText: Employ fire detection systems that activate automatically and notify [Assignment: personnel or roles] and [Assignment: emergency responders] in the event of a fire.

requirements.title: Fire Protection | Suppression Systems — Automatic Activation and Notification
requirements.officialText:
(a) Employ fire suppression systems that activate automatically and notify [Assignment: personnel or roles] and [Assignment: emergency responders] ; and
(b) Employ an automatic fire suppression capability when the facility is not staffed on a continuous basis.

requirements.title: Fire Protection | Inspections
requirements.officialText: Ensure that the facility undergoes [Assignment: frequency] fire protection inspections by authorized and qualified inspectors and identified deficiencies are resolved within [Assignment: time period].

requirements.title: Environmental Controls
requirements.officialText:
a. Maintain [Selection (one or more): temperature; humidity; pressure; radiation; [Assignment: environmental control] ] levels within the facility where the system resides at [Assignment: acceptable levels] ; and

requirements.title: Environmental Controls | Automatic Controls
requirements.officialText: Employ the following automatic environmental controls in the facility to prevent fluctuations potentially harmful to the system: [Assignment: automatic environmental controls].

requirements.title: Environmental Controls | Monitoring with Alarms and Notifications
requirements.officialText: Employ environmental control monitoring that provides an alarm or notification of changes potentially harmful to personnel or equipment to [Assignment: personnel or roles].

requirements.title: Water Damage Protection
requirements.officialText: Protect the system from damage resulting from water leakage by providing master shutoff or isolation valves that are accessible, working properly, and known to key personnel.

requirements.title: Water Damage Protection | Automation Support
requirements.officialText: Detect the presence of water near the system and alert [Assignment: personnel or roles] using [Assignment: automated mechanisms].

requirements.title: Delivery and Removal
requirements.officialText:
a. Authorize and control [Assignment: organization-defined types of system components] entering and exiting the facility; and
b. Maintain records of the system components.

requirements.title: Alternate Work Site
Location of System Components
requirements.officialText: Position system components within the facility to minimize potential damage from [Assignment: physical and environmental hazards] and to minimize the opportunity for unauthorized access.

requirements.title: Information Leakage
requirements.officialText: Protect the system from information leakage due to electromagnetic signals emanations.

requirements.title: Information Leakage | National Emissions Policies and Procedures
requirements.officialText: Protect system components, associated data communications, and networks in accordance with national Emissions Security policies and procedures based on the security category or classification of the information.

requirements.title: Asset Monitoring and Tracking
requirements.officialText: Employ [Assignment: asset location technologies] to track and monitor the location and movement of [Assignment: assets] within [Assignment: controlled areas].

requirements.title: Electromagnetic Pulse Protection
requirements.officialText: Employ [Assignment: protective measures] against electromagnetic pulse damage for [Assignment: system and system components].

requirements.title: Component Marking
requirements.officialText: Mark [Assignment: system hardware components] indicating the impact level or classification level of the information permitted to be processed, stored, or transmitted by the hardware component.

requirements.title: Facility Location
requirements.officialText:
a. Plan the location or site of the facility where the system resides considering physical and environmental hazards; and
b. For existing facilities, consider the physical and environmental hazards in the organizational risk management strategy.

requirements.title: Policy and Procedures

c. Review and update the current planning:
  1. Policy [Assignment: frequency] and following [Assignment: events] ; and
