requirements.title: System Security and Privacy Plans
Rules of Behavior
Rules of Behavior | Social Media and External Site/Application Usage Restrictions
requirements.officialText:
Include in the rules of behavior, restrictions on:
  (a) Use of social media, social networking sites, and external sites/applications;
  (b) Posting organizational information on public websites; and
  (c) Use of organization-provided identifiers (e.g., email addresses) and authentication secrets (e.g., passwords) for creating accounts on external sites/applications.

requirements.title: Concept of Operations
requirements.officialText:
a. Develop a Concept of Operations (CONOPS) for the system describing how the organization intends to operate the system from the perspective of information security and privacy; and
b. Review and update the CONOPS [Assignment: frequency].

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Architectures
Security and Privacy Architectures | Defense in Depth
requirements.officialText:
Design the security and privacy architectures for the system using a defense-in-depth approach that:
  (a) Allocates [Assignment: controls] to [Assignment: locations and architectural layers] ; and
  (b) Ensures that the allocated controls operate in a coordinated and mutually reinforcing manner.

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Architectures | Supplier Diversity
requirements.officialText: Require that [Assignment: controls] allocated to [Assignment: locations and architectural layers] are obtained from different suppliers.

requirements.title: Central Management
requirements.officialText: Centrally manage [Assignment: controls and related processes].

requirements.title: Baseline Selection
requirements.officialText: Select a control baseline for the system.

requirements.title: Baseline Tailoring
requirements.officialText: Tailor the selected control baseline by applying specified tailoring actions.

requirements.title: Information Security Program Plan
Information Security Program Leadership Role
requirements.officialText: Appoint a senior agency information security officer with the mission and resources to coordinate, develop, implement, and maintain an organization-wide information security program.

requirements.title: Information Security and Privacy Resources
Plan of Action and Milestones Process
requirements.officialText:
a. Implement a process to ensure that plans of action and milestones for the information security, privacy, and supply chain risk management programs and associated organizational systems:
  1. Are developed and maintained;
  2. Document the remedial information security, privacy, and supply chain risk management actions to adequately respond to risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation; and
  3. Are reported in accordance with established reporting requirements.
b. Review plans of action and milestones for consistency with the organizational risk management strategy and organization-wide priorities for risk response actions.

requirements.title: System Inventory
requirements.officialText: Develop and update [Assignment: frequency] an inventory of organizational systems.

requirements.title: System Inventory | Inventory of Personally Identifiable Information
requirements.officialText: Establish, maintain, and update [Assignment: frequency] an inventory of all systems, applications, and projects that process personally identifiable information.

requirements.title: Measures of Performance
requirements.officialText: Develop, monitor, and report on the results of information security and privacy measures of performance.

requirements.title: Enterprise Architecture
requirements.officialText: Develop and maintain an enterprise architecture with consideration for information security, privacy, and the resulting risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation.

requirements.title: Enterprise Architecture | Offloading
requirements.officialText: Offload [Assignment: non-essential functions or services] to other systems, system components, or an external provider.

requirements.title: Critical Infrastructure Plan
requirements.officialText: Address information security and privacy issues in the development, documentation, and updating of a critical infrastructure and key resources protection plan.

requirements.title: Risk Management Strategy
requirements.officialText:
a. Develops a comprehensive strategy to manage:
  1. Security risk to organizational operations and assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation associated with the operation and use of organizational systems; and
  2. Privacy risk to individuals resulting from the authorized processing of personally identifiable information;
b. Implement the risk management strategy consistently across the organization; and
c. Review and update the risk management strategy [Assignment: frequency] or as required, to address organizational changes.

requirements.title: Authorization Process
Mission and Business Process Definition
requirements.officialText:
a. Define organizational mission and business processes with consideration for information security and privacy and the resulting risk to organizational operations, organizational assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation; and
b. Determine information protection and personally identifiable information processing needs arising from the defined mission and business processes; and
c. Review and revise the mission and business processes [Assignment: frequency].

requirements.title: Insider Threat Program
requirements.officialText: Implement an insider threat program that includes a cross-discipline insider threat incident handling team.

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Workforce
requirements.officialText: Establish a security and privacy workforce development and improvement program.

requirements.title: Testing, Training, and Monitoring
requirements.officialText:
a. Implement a process for ensuring that organizational plans for conducting security and privacy testing, training, and monitoring activities associated with organizational systems:
  1. Are developed and maintained; and
  2. Continue to be executed; and
b. Review testing, training, and monitoring plans for consistency with the organizational risk management strategy and organization-wide priorities for risk response actions.

requirements.title: Security and Privacy Groups and Associations
requirements.officialText:
Establish and institutionalize contact with selected groups and associations within the security and privacy communities:
  a. To facilitate ongoing security and privacy education and training for organizational personnel;
  b. To maintain currency with recommended security and privacy practices, techniques, and technologies; and
  c. To share current security and privacy information, including threats, vulnerabilities, and incidents.

requirements.title: Threat Awareness Program
requirements.officialText: Implement a threat awareness program that includes a cross-organization information-sharing capability for threat intelligence.

requirements.title: Threat Awareness Program | Automated Means for Sharing Threat Intelligence
requirements.officialText: Employ automated mechanisms to maximize the effectiveness of sharing threat intelligence information.

requirements.title: Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information on External Systems
requirements.officialText:
a. Establish policy and procedures to ensure that requirements for the protection of controlled unclassified information that is processed, stored or transmitted on external systems, are implemented in accordance with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, policies, regulations, and standards; and
b. Review and update the policy and procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

requirements.title: Privacy Program Plan
Privacy Program Leadership Role
requirements.officialText: Appoint a senior agency official for privacy with the authority, mission, accountability, and resources to coordinate, develop, and implement, applicable privacy requirements and manage privacy risks through the organization-wide privacy program.

requirements.title: Dissemination of Privacy Program Information
requirements.officialText:
Maintain a central resource webpage on the organization’s principal public website that serves as a central source of information about the organization’s privacy program and that:
  a. Ensures that the public has access to information about organizational privacy activities and can communicate with its senior agency official for privacy;
  b. Ensures that organizational privacy practices and reports are publicly available; and
  c. Employs publicly facing email addresses and/or phone lines to enable the public to provide feedback and/or direct questions to privacy offices regarding privacy practices.

requirements.title: Dissemination of Privacy Program Information | Privacy Policies on Websites, Applications, and Digital Services
requirements.officialText:
Develop and post privacy policies on all external-facing websites, mobile applications, and other digital services, that:
  (a) Are written in plain language and organized in a way that is easy to understand and navigate;
  (b) Provide information needed by the public to make an informed decision about whether and how to interact with the organization; and
  (c) Are updated whenever the organization makes a substantive change to the practices it describes and includes a time/date stamp to inform the public of the date of the most recent changes.

requirements.title: Accounting of Disclosures
requirements.officialText:
a. Develop and maintain an accurate accounting of disclosures of personally identifiable information, including:
  1. Date, nature, and purpose of each disclosure; and
  2. Name and address, or other contact information of the individual or organization to which the disclosure was made;
b. Retain the accounting of disclosures for the length of the time the personally identifiable information is maintained or five years after the disclosure is made, whichever is longer; and
c. Make the accounting of disclosures available to the individual to whom the personally identifiable information relates upon request.

requirements.title: Personally Identifiable Information Quality Management
Data Governance Body
requirements.officialText: Establish a Data Governance Body consisting of [Assignment: roles] with [Assignment: responsibilities].

Establish a Data Integrity Board to:
  a. Review proposals to conduct or participate in a matching program; and
  b. Conduct an annual review of all matching programs in which the agency has participated.

requirements.title: Minimization of Personally Identifiable Information Used in Testing, Training, and Research
Complaint Management
Privacy Reporting
requirements.officialText:
a. Develop [Assignment: privacy reports] and disseminate to:
  1. [Assignment: oversight bodies] to demonstrate accountability with statutory, regulatory, and policy privacy mandates; and
  2. [Assignment: officials] and other personnel with responsibility for monitoring privacy program compliance; and
b. Review and update privacy reports [Assignment: frequency].

Risk Management Program Leadership Roles
requirements.officialText:
a. Appoint a Senior Accountable Official for Risk Management to align organizational information security and privacy management processes with strategic, operational, and budgetary planning processes; and
b. Establish a Risk Executive (function) to view and analyze risk from an organization-wide perspective and ensure management of risk is consistent across the organization.

requirements.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Strategy

requirements.officialText: Identify, prioritize, and assess suppliers of critical or mission-essential technologies, products, and services.

Purposing
requirements.officialText: Analyze [Assignment: systems or system components] supporting mission essential services or functions to ensure that the information resources are being used consistent with their intended purpose.

requirements.title: Position Risk Designation

requirements.officialText:
a. Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to the system; and
b. Rescreen individuals in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined conditions requiring rescreening and, where rescreening is so indicated, the frequency of rescreening].

requirements.title: Personnel Screening | Classified Information
requirements.officialText: Verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information are cleared and indoctrinated to the highest classification level of the information to which they have access on the system.

requirements.title: Personnel Screening | Formal Indoctrination
requirements.officialText: Verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting types of classified information that require formal indoctrination, are formally indoctrinated for all the relevant types of information to which they have access on the system.

requirements.title: Personnel Screening | Information Requiring Special Protective Measures
requirements.officialText:
Verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting information requiring special protection:
  (a) Have valid access authorizations that are demonstrated by assigned official government duties; and

requirements.officialText: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to use threat modeling and vulnerability analyses from similar systems, components, or services to inform the current development process.

requirements.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Incident Response Plan
requirements.officialText: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to provide, implement, and test an incident response plan.

requirements.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Archive System or Component
requirements.officialText: Require the developer of the system or system component to archive the system or component to be released or delivered together with the corresponding evidence supporting the final security and privacy review.

requirements.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Minimize Personally Identifiable Information
requirements.officialText: Require the developer of the system or system component to minimize the use of personally identifiable information in development and test environments.

requirements.title: Development Process, Standards, and Tools | Logging Syntax
requirements.officialText: Require the developer of the system or system component to minimize the use of personally identifiable information in development and test environments.

requirements.title: Developer-provided Training
requirements.officialText: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to provide the following training on the correct use and operation of the implemented security and privacy functions, controls, and/or mechanisms: [Assignment: training].

requirements.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design
requirements.officialText:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to produce a design specification and security and privacy architecture that:
  a. Is consistent with the organization’s security and privacy architecture that is an integral part the organization’s enterprise architecture;
  b. Accurately and completely describes the required security and privacy functionality, and the allocation of controls among physical and logical components; and
  c. Expresses how individual security and privacy functions, mechanisms, and services work together to provide required security and privacy capabilities and a unified approach to protection.

requirements.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Formal Policy Model
requirements.officialText:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
  (a) Produce, as an integral part of the development process, a formal policy model describing the [Assignment: organization-defined elements of organizational security and privacy policy] to be enforced; and
  (b) Prove that the formal policy model is internally consistent and sufficient to enforce the defined elements of the organizational security and privacy policy when implemented.

requirements.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Security-relevant Components
requirements.officialText:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
  (a) Define security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware; and
  (b) Provide a rationale that the definition for security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware is complete.

requirements.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Formal Correspondence
Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Informal Correspondence
Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Conceptually Simple Design
requirements.officialText:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
  (a) Design and structure the security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to use a complete, conceptually simple protection mechanism with precisely defined semantics; and
  (b) Internally structure the security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware with specific regard for this mechanism.

requirements.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Structure for Testing
requirements.officialText: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to structure security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to facilitate testing.

requirements.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Structure for Least Privilege
requirements.officialText: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to structure security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to facilitate controlling access with least privilege.

requirements.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Orchestration
requirements.officialText: Design [Assignment: critical systems] with coordinated behavior to implement the following capabilities: [Assignment: capabilities].

requirements.title: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design | Design Diversity
requirements.officialText: Use different designs for [Assignment: critical systems] to satisfy a common set of requirements or to provide equivalent functionality.

requirements.title: Customized Development of Critical Components
requirements.officialText: Reimplement or custom develop the following critical system components: [Assignment: critical system].

requirements.title: Developer Screening
requirements.officialText:
Require that the developer of [Assignment: system, systems component, or system service]:
  a. Has appropriate access authorizations as determined by assigned [Assignment: official government duties] ; and
  b. Satisfies the following additional personnel screening criteria: [Assignment: additional personnel screening criteria].

requirements.title: Unsupported System Components
requirements.officialText:
a. Replace system components when support for the components is no longer available from the developer, vendor, or manufacturer; or
b. Provide the following options for alternative sources for continued support for unsupported components [Selection (one or more): in-house support; [Assignment: support from external providers] ].

requirements.title: Specialization
requirements.officialText: Employ [Selection (one or more): design modification; augmentation; reconfiguration] on [Assignment: systems or system components] supporting mission essential services or functions to increase the trustworthiness in those systems or components.

requirements.title: Design For Cyber Resiliency
requirements.officialText:
a. Design organizational systems, system components, or system services to achieve cyber resiliency by:
  1. Defining the following cyber resiliency goals: [Assignment: cyber resiliency goals].
  2. Defining the following cyber resiliency objectives: [Assignment: cyber resiliency objectives].
  3. Defining the following cyber resiliency techniques: [Assignment: cyber resiliency techniques].
  4. Defining the following cyber resiliency implementation approaches: [Assignment: cyber resiliency implementation approaches].
  5. Defining the following cyber resiliency design principles: [Assignment: cyber resiliency design principles].
b. Implement the selected cyber resiliency goals, objectives, techniques, implementation approaches, and design principles as part of an organizational risk management process or systems security engineering process.

requirements.title: Policy and Procedures
requirements.officialText:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business-process-level; system-level] system and communications protection policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and communications protection policy and the associated system and communications protection controls;
b. Designate an [Assignment: official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the system and communications protection policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current system and communications protection:
  1. Policy [Assignment: frequency] and following [Assignment: events] ; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: frequency] and following [Assignment: events].

requirements.title: Separation of System and User Functionality
requirements.officialText: Separate user functionality, including user interface services, from system management functionality.

requirements.title: Separation of System and User Functionality | Interfaces for Non-privileged Users
requirements.officialText: Prevent the presentation of system management functionality at interfaces to non-privileged users.

requirements.title: Separation of System and User Functionality | Disassociability
requirements.officialText: Store state information from applications and software separately.

requirements.title: Security Function Isolation
requirements.officialText: Isolate security functions from nonsecurity functions.

requirements.title: Security Function Isolation | Hardware Separation
requirements.officialText: Employ hardware separation mechanisms to implement security function isolation.

requirements.title: Security Function Isolation | Access and Flow Control Functions
requirements.officialText: Isolate security functions enforcing access and information flow control from nonsecurity functions and from other security functions.

requirements.title: Security Function Isolation | Minimize Nonsecurity Functionality
requirements.officialText: Minimize the number of nonsecurity functions included within the isolation boundary containing security functions.

requirements.title: Security Function Isolation | Module Coupling and Cohesiveness
requirements.officialText: Implement security functions as largely independent modules that maximize internal cohesiveness within modules and minimize coupling between modules.

requirements.title: Security Function Isolation | Layered Structures
requirements.officialText: Implement security functions as a layered structure minimizing interactions between layers of the design and avoiding any dependence by lower layers on the functionality or correctness of higher layers.

requirements.title: Information in Shared System Resources
requirements.officialText: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

requirements.title: Information in Shared System Resources | Multilevel or Periods Processing
requirements.officialText: Prevent unauthorized information transfer via shared resources in accordance with [Assignment: procedures] when system processing explicitly switches between different information classification levels or security categories.

requirements.title: Denial-of-service Protection | Restrict Ability to Attack Other Systems
requirements.officialText: Restrict the ability of individuals to launch the following denial-of-service attacks against other systems: [Assignment: denial-of-service attacks].

requirements.title: Denial-of-service Protection | Capacity, Bandwidth, and Redundancy
requirements.officialText: Manage capacity, bandwidth, or other redundancy to limit the effects of information flooding denial-of-service attacks.

requirements.title: Denial-of-service Protection | Detection and Monitoring
requirements.officialText:
(a) Employ the following monitoring tools to detect indicators of denial-of-service attacks against, or launched from, the system: [Assignment: monitoring tools] ; and

requirements.title: Resource Availability
requirements.officialText: Protect the availability of resources by allocating [Assignment: resources] by [Selection (one or more): priority; quota; [Assignment: controls] ].

requirements.officialText: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception [Selection (one or more): at managed interfaces; for [Assignment: systems] ].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Split Tunneling for Remote Devices
requirements.officialText: Prevent split tunneling for remote devices connecting to organizational systems unless the split tunnel is securely provisioned using [Assignment: safeguards].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Route Traffic to Authenticated Proxy Servers
requirements.officialText: Route [Assignment: internal communications traffic] to [Assignment: external networks] through authenticated proxy servers at managed interfaces.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Restrict Threatening Outgoing Communications Traffic
requirements.officialText:
(a) Detect and deny outgoing communications traffic posing a threat to external systems; and
(b) Audit the identity of internal users associated with denied communications.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Prevent Exfiltration
requirements.officialText:
(a) Prevent the exfiltration of information; and
(b) Conduct exfiltration tests [Assignment: frequency].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Restrict Incoming Communications Traffic
requirements.officialText: Only allow incoming communications from [Assignment: authorized sources] to be routed to [Assignment: authorized destinations].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Host-based Protection
requirements.officialText: Implement [Assignment: host-based boundary protection mechanisms] at [Assignment: system components].

requirements.officialText: Isolate [Assignment: information security tools, mechanisms, and support components] from other internal system components by implementing physically separate subnetworks with managed interfaces to other components of the system.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Protect Against Unauthorized Physical Connections
requirements.officialText: Protect against unauthorized physical connections at [Assignment: managed interfaces].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Networked Privileged Accesses
requirements.officialText: Route networked, privileged accesses through a dedicated, managed interface for purposes of access control and auditing.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Prevent Discovery of System Components
requirements.officialText: Prevent the discovery of specific system components that represent a managed interface.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Automated Enforcement of Protocol Formats
requirements.officialText: Enforce adherence to protocol formats.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Fail Secure
requirements.officialText: Prevent systems from entering unsecure states in the event of an operational failure of a boundary protection device.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Block Communication from Non-organizationally Configured Hosts
requirements.officialText: Block inbound and outbound communications traffic between [Assignment: communication clients] that are independently configured by end users and external service providers.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Dynamic Isolation and Segregation
requirements.officialText: Provide the capability to dynamically isolate [Assignment: system components] from other system components.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Isolation of System Components
requirements.officialText: Employ boundary protection mechanisms to isolate [Assignment: system components] supporting [Assignment: missions and/or business functions].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Separate Subnets for Connecting to Different Security Domains
requirements.officialText: Implement separate network addresses to connect to systems in different security domains.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Disable Sender Feedback on Protocol Validation Failure
requirements.officialText: Disable feedback to senders on protocol format validation failure.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Personally Identifiable Information
Boundary Protection | Unclassified National Security System Connections
requirements.officialText: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: unclassified national security system] to an external network without the use of [Assignment: boundary protection device].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Classified National Security System Connections
requirements.officialText: Prohibit the direct connection of a classified national security system to an external network without the use of [Assignment: boundary protection device].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Unclassified Non-national Security System Connections
requirements.officialText: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: unclassified, non-national security system] to an external network without the use of [Assignment: boundary protection device].

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Connections to Public Networks
requirements.officialText: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: system] to a public network.

requirements.title: Boundary Protection | Separate Subnets to Isolate Functions
requirements.officialText: Implement [Selection: physically; logically] separate subnetworks to isolate the following critical system components and functions: [Assignment: critical system components and functions].

requirements.officialText: Protect the [Selection (one or more): confidentiality; integrity] of transmitted information.

requirements.officialText: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to [Selection (one or more): prevent unauthorized disclosure of information; detect changes to information] during transmission.

requirements.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Pre- and Post-transmission Handling
requirements.officialText: Maintain the [Selection (one or more): confidentiality; integrity] of information during preparation for transmission and during reception.

requirements.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Cryptographic Protection for Message Externals
requirements.officialText: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect message externals unless otherwise protected by [Assignment: alternative physical controls].

requirements.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Conceal or Randomize Communications
requirements.officialText: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to conceal or randomize communication patterns unless otherwise protected by [Assignment: alternative physical controls].

requirements.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Protected Distribution System
requirements.officialText: Implement [Assignment: protected distribution system] to [Selection (one or more): prevent unauthorized disclosure of information; detect changes to information] during transmission.

requirements.title: Network Disconnect
requirements.officialText: Terminate the network connection associated with a communications session at the end of the session or after [Assignment: time period] of inactivity.

requirements.title: Trusted Path
requirements.officialText:
a. Provide a [Selection: physically; logically] isolated trusted communications path for communications between the user and the trusted components of the system; and
b. Permit users to invoke the trusted communications path for communications between the user and the following security functions of the system, including at a minimum, authentication and re-authentication: [Assignment: security functions].

requirements.title: Trusted Path | Irrefutable Communications Path
requirements.officialText:
(a) Provide a trusted communications path that is irrefutably distinguishable from other communications paths; and
(b) Initiate the trusted communications path for communications between the [Assignment: security functions] of the system and the user.

requirements.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
requirements.officialText: Establish and manage cryptographic keys when cryptography is employed within the system in accordance with the following key management requirements: [Assignment: requirements].

requirements.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Availability
requirements.officialText: Maintain availability of information in the event of the loss of cryptographic keys by users.

requirements.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Symmetric Keys
requirements.officialText: Produce, control, and distribute symmetric cryptographic keys using [Selection: NIST FIPS-validated; NSA-approved] key management technology and processes.

requirements.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Asymmetric Keys
requirements.officialText: Produce, control, and distribute asymmetric cryptographic keys using [Selection: NSA-approved key management technology and processes; prepositioned keying material; DoD-approved or DoD-issued Medium Assurance PKI certificates; DoD-approved or DoD-issued Medium Hardware Assurance PKI certificates and hardware security tokens that protect the user’s private key; certificates issued in accordance with organization-defined requirements].

requirements.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management | Physical Control of Keys
requirements.officialText: Maintain physical control of cryptographic keys when stored information is encrypted by external service providers.

requirements.title: Cryptographic Protection
requirements.officialText:
a. Determine the [Assignment: cryptographic uses] ; and
b. Implement the following types of cryptography required for each specified cryptographic use: [Assignment: types of cryptography].

requirements.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications
requirements.officialText:
a. Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and applications with the following exceptions: [Assignment: exceptions where remote activation is to be allowed] ; and
b. Provide an explicit indication of use to users physically present at the devices.

requirements.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Physical or Logical Disconnect
requirements.officialText: Provide [Selection (one or more): physical; logical] disconnect of collaborative computing devices in a manner that supports ease of use.

requirements.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Disabling and Removal in Secure Work Areas
requirements.officialText: Disable or remove collaborative computing devices and applications from [Assignment: systems or system components] in [Assignment: secure work areas].

requirements.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications | Explicitly Indicate Current Participants
requirements.officialText: Provide an explicit indication of current participants in [Assignment: online meetings and teleconferences].

requirements.title: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes
requirements.officialText: Associate [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with information exchanged between systems and between system components.

requirements.title: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Integrity Verification
requirements.officialText: Verify the integrity of transmitted security and privacy attributes.

requirements.title: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Anti-spoofing Mechanisms
requirements.officialText: Implement anti-spoofing mechanisms to prevent adversaries from falsifying the security attributes indicating the successful application of the security process.

requirements.title: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes | Cryptographic Binding
requirements.officialText: Implement [Assignment: mechanisms or techniques] to bind security and privacy attributes to transmitted information.

requirements.title: Public Key Infrastructure Certificates
requirements.officialText:
a. Issue public key certificates under an [Assignment: certificate policy] or obtain public key certificates from an approved service provider; and
b. Include only approved trust anchors in trust stores or certificate stores managed by the organization.

requirements.title: Mobile Code
requirements.officialText:
a. Define acceptable and unacceptable mobile code and mobile code technologies; and

requirements.officialText: Identify [Assignment: unacceptable mobile code] and take [Assignment: corrective actions].

requirements.title: Mobile Code | Acquisition, Development, and Use
requirements.officialText: Verify that the acquisition, development, and use of mobile code to be deployed in the system meets [Assignment: mobile code requirements].

requirements.title: Mobile Code | Prevent Downloading and Execution
requirements.officialText: Prevent the download and execution of [Assignment: unacceptable mobile code].

requirements.officialText: Prevent the automatic execution of mobile code in [Assignment: software applications] and enforce [Assignment: actions] prior to executing the code.

requirements.title: Mobile Code | Allow Execution Only in Confined Environments
requirements.officialText: Allow execution of permitted mobile code only in confined virtual machine environments.

requirements.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Authoritative Source)
requirements.officialText:
a. Provide additional data origin authentication and integrity verification artifacts along with the authoritative name resolution data the system returns in response to external name/address resolution queries; and
b. Provide the means to indicate the security status of child zones and (if the child supports secure resolution services) to enable verification of a chain of trust among parent and child domains, when operating as part of a distributed, hierarchical namespace.

requirements.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Authoritative Source) | Data Origin and Integrity
requirements.officialText: Provide data origin and integrity protection artifacts for internal name/address resolution queries.

requirements.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Recursive or Caching Resolver)
requirements.officialText: Request and perform data origin authentication and data integrity verification on the name/address resolution responses the system receives from authoritative sources.

requirements.title: Architecture and Provisioning for Name/Address Resolution Service
requirements.officialText: Ensure the systems that collectively provide name/address resolution service for an organization are fault-tolerant and implement internal and external role separation.

requirements.title: Session Authenticity
requirements.officialText: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

requirements.title: Session Authenticity | Invalidate Session Identifiers at Logout
requirements.officialText: Invalidate session identifiers upon user logout or other session termination.

requirements.title: Session Authenticity | Unique System-generated Session Identifiers
requirements.officialText: Generate a unique session identifier for each session with [Assignment: randomness requirements] and recognize only session identifiers that are system-generated.

requirements.title: Session Authenticity | Allowed Certificate Authorities
requirements.officialText: Only allow the use of [Assignment: certificated authorities] for verification of the establishment of protected sessions.

requirements.title: Platform-independent Applications
requirements.officialText: Include within organizational systems the following platform independent applications: [Assignment: platform-independent applications].

requirements.officialText: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure and modification of the following information at rest on [Assignment: system components or media]: [Assignment: information].

requirements.officialText: Provide protected storage for cryptographic keys [Selection: [Assignment: safeguards] ; hardware-protected key store].

requirements.officialText: Employ virtualization techniques to support the deployment of a diversity of operating systems and applications that are changed [Assignment: frequency].

requirements.officialText: Employ [Assignment: techniques] to introduce randomness into organizational operations and assets.

requirements.officialText: Employ the following techniques to hide or conceal [Assignment: system components]: [Assignment: techniques].

requirements.officialText: Measure the bandwidth of [Assignment: subset of identified covert channels] in the operational environment of the system.

requirements.officialText: Partition privileged functions into separate physical domains.
